item.title: Authorities say Flock cameras' data allegedly used for immigration enforcement
item.description:

However, Dickstein said that the officials were responsible for policy violations. According to the Dayton newspaper, Dickstein said that the city officials “enthusiastically” support outside authorities joining the investigation to determine what happened.
